# Modular 3D Hospital Environment

The assets under `/Game/Hospital/Imported` were created from the free
**Modular 3D hospital environment** pack by Madd Game Art:

https://www.fab.com/listings/7e1574fd-1d28-4c6f-a612-c889c09078ef

The publisher permits use in commercial and non-commercial projects,
modification for project needs, and private sharing within the development
team. The source assets may not be resold or redistributed as a standalone
asset pack, including modified versions.

The playable `/Game/Hospital/Maps/Lvl_Hospital` layout, lighting, gameplay
spawns, material setup, and Unreal integration were created for IT Learns.
